req.title: Redirect once when n==1
req.statement: The system shall respond with a single 302 to /get when /redirect/1 is called.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /redirect/1 must issue exactly one 302 redirect to /get, and the final response (after following the redirect) must be HTTP 200 with the expected JSON payload. We need: (1) a positive test confirming the 302 + Location header and the final 200 payload; (2) a boundary test at n==1 (the exact threshold where the code branches to url_for('view_get') instead of _redirect()); (3) a negative test confirming that without redirect-following the raw response is 302 (not 200, not 301, not 303); (4) a state-transition test confirming the redirect chain terminates in exactly one hop; (5) a decision-table test confirming the Location header points to /get and not some other path. These together kill off-by-one mutations (n==1 vs n==0 or n==2), status-code mutations (302->301, 302->303), and Location-value mutations.

tests.name: test_redirect_1_returns_302_with_location_to_get
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client with follow_redirects=False
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_returns_302_with_location_to_get():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.endswith('/get'), f'Expected Location ending in /get, got: {location}'

test_redirect_1_returns_302_with_location_to_get()

tests.name: test_redirect_1_status_is_not_301_or_303
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Create Flask test client with follow_redirects=False
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: must be 302, not any other redirect or success code
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_status_is_not_301_or_303():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code != 301, 'Must not be 301 Moved Permanently'
    assert r.status_code != 303, 'Must not be 303 See Other'
    assert r.status_code != 200, 'Must not be 200 OK (no redirect followed)'
    assert r.status_code != 307, 'Must not be 307 Temporary Redirect'
    assert r.status_code == 302

test_redirect_1_status_is_not_301_or_303()

tests.name: test_redirect_1_boundary_exactly_one_hop
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
n==1 is the exact boundary where code branches to url_for('view_get')
actions: GET /redirect/1 with follow_redirects=False to capture first response
Follow Location header manually to confirm it resolves to /get
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: n==1 boundary — exactly one redirect hop, not zero, not two
tests.executable:
import json
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_boundary_exactly_one_hop():
    r1 = client.get('/redirect/1', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r1.status_code == 302
    location = r1.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert '/redirect/' not in location, f'Should not redirect to another /redirect/N, got: {location}'
    assert location.endswith('/get'), f'Location must end with /get, got: {location}'
    r2 = client.get(location, follow_redirects=False)
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r2.data)
    assert 'url' in body

test_redirect_1_boundary_exactly_one_hop()

tests.name: test_redirect_2_does_not_go_directly_to_get
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
n==2 is one above the n==1 boundary
expected: Location header does NOT end with /get (it should point to /redirect/1)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: n==2 (boundary+1) must NOT go directly to /get — catches off-by-one mutation n==1 -> n==2
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_2_does_not_go_directly_to_get():
    r = client.get('/redirect/2', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert not location.endswith('/get'), (
        f'n==2 should NOT redirect directly to /get, got Location: {location}'
    )
    assert '/redirect/' in location or location != '/get', (
        f'n==2 should chain through another redirect, got: {location}'
    )

test_redirect_2_does_not_go_directly_to_get()

tests.name: test_redirect_1_absolute_true_location_is_absolute_url
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: absolute=true branch — url_for('view_get', _external=True) produces absolute URL
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_1_absolute_true_location_is_absolute_url():
    r = client.get('/redirect/1?absolute=true', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 302
    location = r.headers.get('Location', '')
    assert location.startswith('http'), (
        f'Expected absolute URL starting with http, got: "{location}"'
    )
    assert location.endswith('/get'), (
        f'Expected Location ending with /get, got: "{location}"'
    )

test_redirect_1_absolute_true_location_is_absolute_url()

tests.name: test_redirect_0_returns_500_or_error
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
n==0 violates the assert n > 0 precondition in redirect_n_times
expected: Response status code is 500 (AssertionError triggers internal server error)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-022: n==0 is below boundary — assert n > 0 fires; catches mutation n > 0 -> n >= 0
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
app.config['TESTING'] = False
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_0_returns_500_or_error():
    r = client.get('/redirect/0', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 500, (
        f'Expected 500 for n==0 (assert n>0 should fire), got: {r.status_code}'
    )
    assert r.status_code != 302

test_redirect_0_returns_500_or_error()
